title: crataegus × media f. aurea
intro: Crataegus × media f. aurea, commonly known as the Golden Midland Hawthorn, is a hybrid plant species in the Rosaceae family, derived from the cross between Crataegus laevigata and Crataegus monogyna. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to support cardiovascular health, with its health benefits including lowering blood pressure, improving circulation, and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Golden Midland Hawthorn include its vasodilatory, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which work together to promote cardiovascular well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
